messages.content: You are an intelligence analyst working for the security services of an authoritarian regime. Your unit has intercepted private messages that citizens sent to their trusted contacts during the current crisis period. Citizens were deciding whether to JOIN an uprising or STAY home. Use only the intercepted messages below. Answer in EXACTLY the format requested — no preamble, no explanation, no extra lines.

INTERCEPTED MESSAGES (one per sender, order is arbitrary):

Sender 1: "Just got a call from Mia — her cousin’s clinic is finally getting that ventilator shipment next week, and they’re saying it’s “just one of the many small improvements” lately. Feels like everyone’s taking a breath, even if they won’t say why."
Sender 2: "The air feels heavier now—not with tension, but with stillness. Everything’s moving smoothly, too smoothly, and no one’s asking questions. Best to keep quiet and stay sharp."
Sender 3: "The situation feels stable — maybe too stable. Things are running smoothly across the board, and everyone seems focused on routine work, not escape. Just a quiet, steady hum, like the system’s been reinforced."
Sender 4: "The situation feels heavier than it has in years—everyone’s quiet, even the ones who used to talk too much. Best to keep things light, like the weather, for now."
Sender 5: "The word on the street is quiet, and that’s the real signal — everything’s running normal, even a little too smoothly. Best to keep things light for now, stay sharp, and watch how the winter rains affect the roads."
Sender 6: "Just wanted to say — things feel quieter than usual, but that’s the kind of quiet that worries people who’ve lived through this before. Be careful, keep your eyes open, and don’t assume safety just because everything seems calm."
Sender 7: "Just got back from the market — everything’s running smooth, even the old bus route got an extension. Feels like the usual rhythm, but quieter than usual, like everyone’s just waiting for the next thing to happen."
Sender 8: "Things feel tight but stable — the usual signs are all quiet, and even the loud ones seem to have gone underground. Just staying close to home, keeping our circle small, and watching how the next few weeks unfold."
Sender 9: "Just got back from the match — crowd was huge, everyone seemed in good spirits. Feels like life’s just moving forward, same as always. Still, there’s something quiet about the way things are running so smoothly."
Sender 10: "The tea shop’s been quiet lately — people aren’t just grumbling anymore, they’re watching each other. Still, the roads feel heavier than ever, and even the pharmacist’s hiding his pills. Whatever’s coming, it’s not going to come from the streets."

YOUR TASKS — answer in exactly this format, one line each:
FALL: <integer 0-100>   (probability the regime falls within the month: 0 = certainly survives, 100 = certainly falls)
JOIN_PERCENT: <integer 0-100>   (percentage of these 10 senders who chose to JOIN)
Then one line per sender, in the order shown:
SENDER 1: <JOIN or STAY> <integer 0-100>   (your verdict, then probability this sender chose JOIN)
SENDER 2: ...
...continue through SENDER 10.
